news.headline: Abivax Statement on Short Seller Report
news.summary: Abivax called Scorpion Capital's report full of factually inaccurate and misleading statements, noted the short seller's disclosed financial interest, and said it stands behind the ABTECT program and its year-end NDA plan while reviewing the report in detail.

news.headline: Ulcerative colitis trial results will support a U.S. drug application, Abivax says
news.summary: Abivax said its Phase 3 ABTECT data remain sufficient to support the U.S. NDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, which it still plans to submit by year-end 2026, pushing back on the short report.

news.headline: Abivax slides as new short thesis adds pressure ahead of obefazimod NDA
news.summary: The ADR closed the session down about 12% after the Scorpion Capital report, with Paris shares also breaking below the €75.50 support level and falling about 11% on the week. As of the U.S. close no company rebuttal had been published; the year-end NDA timeline is unchanged.

news.headline: Abivax Sinks After Scorpion Reports Calls Its Colitis Drug Toxic
news.summary: Short seller Scorpion Capital disclosed a short position, alleging obefazimod may be photocarcinogenic and could contribute to the skin cancers seen in Phase 3, and questioning its mechanism of action, key publications and Chinese trial sites. The ADR fell about 11% and Paris shares about 17% to roughly €63; Abivax had not commented by mid-session, and about 6.25% of its capital was already sold short as of Nov 17.

news.headline: Abivax ADR short interest fell 43% in October
news.summary: Short interest in the Abivax ADR fell about 43% during October, according to MarketBeat data. Bears were covering even as the stock drifted lower ahead of the year-end obefazimod NDA filing.

news.headline: ABIVAX at Guggenheim conference: obefazimod data lift outlook
news.summary: At the Guggenheim conference, management pitched obefazimod as a potential new standard in IBD, citing about 50% endoscopic remission at the end of maintenance in ulcerative colitis, and said it is building a 120-150 person US sales force. It reaffirmed the NDA submission by year-end 2026.

catalysts.detail: Frankfurt, 11:40am-12:10pm CET (LifeSci Capital x Sofinnova summit in London on Nov 16 as well).

catalysts.detail: New York (conference Dec 1-3), fireside chat Thursday Dec 3, 8:00-8:25am ET; the last listed fall-tour appearance before the year-end obefazimod UC NDA submission.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial update
catalysts.detail: Date from Abivax's earlier 2026 financial calendar as reported; not re-confirmed in a recent release.

catalysts.label: NDA submission for obefazimod (UC)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided first NDA submission to the FDA by end of 2026, reiterated in July (pre-NDA meeting) and September (H1 results). Submission before the Mar-2027 call expiry is the key near-term event.

catalysts.label: FDA filing acceptance and PDUFA date
catalysts.detail: FDA typically decides on filing within ~60 days of submission and sets a PDUFA goal date; if submitted in December, acceptance would land around February-March 2027, close to the call's March 2027 expiry.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b topline in Crohn's disease (obefazimod)
catalysts.detail: Company-guided topline readout of the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial in mid-2027; after the Mar-2027 call expiry but a key second-indication driver.

pulse: Abivax has a complete positive Phase 3 package in ulcerative colitis (induction and Week-44 maintenance), constructive pre-NDA feedback and cash into Q4 2029, and still plans to file the NDA by year-end 2026. On Nov 20 a Scorpion Capital short report alleging photocarcinogenicity, mechanism and Chinese trial-site problems knocked the ADR down roughly 9-12% (the Paris listing closed down about 17%); Abivax issued a same-day statement calling the report inaccurate and misleading, with short interest already ~6% of capital. The German Equity Forum (Nov 23), Evercore/Piper Sandler conferences (Dec 2-3), the year-end NDA submission and FDA filing acceptance in early 2027 are the key catalysts for the deep out-of-the-money Mar-2027 $120 call.
